request: B: (0) ANCHORS (answers your question): no get_anchors() needed, use these Sim getters: Sim.get_bench_x(), Sim.get_counter_x(), Sim.get_door_x(). In world coords the LP car spans x 3600-5400; bench=4085 (car-local 485, matches your hardcode), counter=4800, door=5340. (1) INTERVIEW: Sim.ask(pid,q) -> {ok,line,attr,value,car_id}. q0 = where last (line only, car_id = car to hint at). q1/q2 reveal DIFFERENT attrs, text comes from content/dialogue.json by mood; after the clues run out you get attr=='' and a graceful 'that's all' line (disable the buttons then). Labels for the 3 buttons: Content.dialogue['ask_labels']. Each answer is also emitted via Events.passenger_said. Ledger claims entries now carry 'answers':[{attr,value,line}]. (2) IMPOSTERS: kind=='imposter' passengers appear from tier 2 (Sim.spawn_imposter() also exists for cheats). They walk/queue like claimants, name from names.json, random 'look' dict (same keys as owners' looks). Exactly ONE of the two things they tell you via q1/q2 is wrong (catchable with the bench tools). Sim.refuse(pid) pays the bonus; hand_over to an imposter pays nothing and the item returns at the next stop. (3) WRITING you can read: Content.barks / Content.dialogue / Content.names, helper Content.lines('barks',['thanks','calm']) -> Array. See _doc at the top of each file. Barks ambient.* are for your ambient passenger speech bubbles, station.announce uses {stop}, claimant_intro uses {item}. (4) Earlier notes still hold: clue signal Events.clue_revealed_v2, reveal() needs the item on the bench, bench cap 3, save user://save_v2.json, Sim.skip_tutorial for shots, items are i101.., Cheats.run('trigger_first_minute') is still a stub. || (5) AMBIENT (A2.1): kind=='ambient' passengers now have state seated|standing_up|walking|idle|leaving and a 'routine' key (reading|napping|eating|staring|chatting|kids|vendor|conductor). When the routine changes Sim emits Events.passenger_state_changed(pid, <routine name>) while state stays 'seated'. role 'conductor'/'vendor' are the two walkers (they pause in state 'idle'). Seated ones have x at their seat (car.x+300+130*slot), facing, look{...height: kids are 0.7}, name from names.json, seat_slot id like car_pass_a3, partner pid for chatting pairs (both have routine chatting). Boarders spawn at their car's door (car.x+1740) in state 'walking' and walk to the seat; leavers stand_up -> leaving -> walk to the door and passenger_left fires there. Ambient chatter arrives via Events.passenger_said (only when within 1200px of the attendant, max one line per 5 s) - show those bubbles briefly. Items under seats appear via the normal Events.item_spawned. || (6) NEW claimant states: after walking to the door, shy/worried people go through state 'hesitating' (~2.2 s) and grumpy/hurried through 'knocking' (~1 s) before joining the queue; calm walk straight in. Sim.call_next() now makes the next seated claimant stand up immediately and returns {ok,queue,called:pid}. Cheats.run('trigger_first_minute') and Cheats.run('skip_next_stop') work now in your screenshot setups (they are locked outside screenshot mode). Spot kinds now differ per car (dine: tables, sleeper: curtains, obs: sills, luggage: racks); lp/pass unchanged. || A->B: Sim.get_shop() entries now {id,name,desc,kind,level,max_level,cost,owned,maxed,affordable}; Sim.buy(id)->{ok,reason,level}; Sim.get_bench_cap() (bench cap can be 3-5, don't hardcode); Sim.get_upgrade_level(id). Cosmetic ids: brass_cap, velvet_curtains, lantern_charm (owned when level>0). || A->B: hand_over result may carry res.arc_line (also emitted via passenger_said + toast kind 'story'). || A->B daily: Sim.get_daily()->{date,number,def_id,title,owner_id,started,done,wrong,available,share}; Sim.start_daily() spawns today's item+owner; Events.daily_completed(result); Sim.daily_share_text() (''if unsolved/cheated).
